rationale: The workflow builds Rust-based Python wheels across multiple platforms using maturin. Each job downloads the Rust toolchain and fetches Cargo dependencies from scratch. Adding GitHub Actions caching for the Cargo registry (~/.cargo/registry) and git dependencies (~/.cargo/git) keyed by Cargo.lock avoids repeated dependency downloads on subsequent workflow runs. This applies the P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern (cache dependency downloads) which is supported by literature (S01, Table 4) and experimental evidence showing ~51% elapsed-time savings for Maven dependency caching (experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-a89d5fd8d30bc8cb-r2) and similar pip caching benefits (experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2). The change preserves all build targets, test coverage, and artifact outputs while only inserting cache steps before the maturin build. The checkout action is also pinned to a specific SHA (v7.0.1) for supply-chain security.
